summary: This batch improves media privacy, audio pipeline robustness, and internal media APIs: Picture-in-Picture now spoofs reported size under RFP (Resist Fingerprinting) for privacy, audio session and focus metrics (Glean) were added, AudioWorklet message passing got native support, and the media track/graph lifecycle and message dispatching were refactored. Validation of encoder input sizes, clamping of picture regions, live-stream controllability, and various locking/guarding changes make media playback, recording, and privacy behavior more consistent and resilient.
